purpose: Beta 0 runs the product Supervisor and Gateway adapter against this candidate to answer one question with evidence: does the embedded Gateway serve authenticated RPC natively on each target platform, or does a platform need a Linux subsystem. A candidate is never advertised, never promoted automatically, and never treated as the locked release train.
why: The locked train pins openclaw 2026.7.1-2 from 2026-07-18. At capture time npm stable is 2026.9.1, two release cycles ahead.

OpenClaw publishes @openclaw/gateway-client and @openclaw/gateway-protocol as stable packages from 2026.8.1 onward. D-0013 assumed no public client package exists and planned a hand-rolled WebSocket client; that assumption is now false, so the candidate consumes the published packages instead.
The published package set ships docs/gateway/embedding.md, a first-party contract for supervising the Gateway as a child process. Beta 0 follows it rather than inventing a lifecycle.

The first Windows CI run showed the Gateway starts and completes the operator handshake natively, with no Linux subsystem, then fast-fails inside libuv's filesystem watcher when its state directory is an 8.3 short path. The host now resolves paths to their long form before handing them to the child (R-034).

evidence.note: The Gateway starts, listens and completes the operator handshake natively on windows-latest, with no Linux subsystem. Run 15 on the same runner crashed in libuv's filesystem watcher until the host resolved its state directory out of 8.3 short form (R-034).

promotionBlockers: Capability manifest diff between 2026.7.1-2 and the candidate has not been produced; the 23 locked capability families still describe the older train.
SBOM baseline and third-party license inventory have not been regenerated for the candidate dependency tree.
Three-platform smoke passes on CI runners only. A clean Windows machine and a real Mac have not installed or run the app, and CI proves neither the installer nor the user experience.
The default agent runtime in a fresh state directory is codex, whose harness plugin is absent; a supported runtime and provider path has not been chosen or tested.
Independent senior platform and security review of the supervised runtime has not happened.
